title: 第3章 豪门千金（3）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    时笙和南宫夫人待到宴会开始，两人才结伴下去，南宫景一早就离开了，估计是不放心苏衣衣。

    对于应酬这种事，时笙是不喜欢的，但是身在这个圈子，这些应酬却是必须的。

    “许小姐是越长越漂亮，景少可是好福气啊，不像我们家那小子，现在还没个着落。”姿容端庄的妇人一脸羡慕的看着南宫夫人，引起旁边的几位妇人齐齐附和。

    “所以这好媳妇，就得早早的定下。”

    “哎，那也得看有没有福气，你看林家那个，不也是娃娃亲？结果呢？闹得一家不得安宁。诶，我不是说许小姐，许小姐可别多心。”

    丫的拐弯抹角的膈应人，当人听不出来啊？

    时笙扯着嘴角敷衍的笑着，眼底满是不耐烦，要不是她醒过来的时候车子已经到外面了，她是绝对不会进来的。

    三个女人一台戏，特么的这一群女人，得多少出戏。

    “伯母，我爸爸来了，我过去一下。”时笙看到许父，立即借口溜走。

    这些人有钱有势，什么都有了，唯一的娱乐就只剩下攀比。

    比爹，比丈夫，比孩子，比赢了就能高人一等似的。

    “爸爸。”时笙走到许父跟前，态度温和的叫了一声。

    “你这丫头来这么早，怎么，没和阿景一起？”许父在她身后看了一圈，没看到南宫景，不免有些疑惑。

    “嗯，他有事。”时笙脸上的笑容多了几分真诚，“妈妈怎么没来？”

    “公司临时有事，去了分公司，你这丫头什么时候也会关心我们两个老的了，我还以为你眼里只有心上人呢！”许父打趣，满脸的喜色，可见许父对原主是有多么的宠爱。

    “人是会长大的。”时笙眨眨眼。

    “好好好，我们家丫头长大了。”

    都换了个芯子，当然不一样了！

    原主的遗愿之一可是要好好孝敬父母。

    许父带着时笙先给今晚的寿星敬了酒，又领着时笙在人群中转了一圈，一溜下去，该认识的也都认识了。

    许父对自家女儿今天这么乖巧，心底越发的欣慰，果然是长大了。

    时笙喝了一些酒，脑袋有些晕，和许父说了一声，往花园走去，醒醒神。

    南宫家的花园很大，时笙找了地方坐着，夜间的凉风一吹，脑袋果然清醒了不少。

    “你刚才和他在做什么？”隐含怒气的声音将昏昏欲睡的时笙惊醒。

    时笙揉了揉脸，扒拉着椅背往后面看去，后面是几颗树木，隐约有两道身影站在树木后面。

Page (1/3)

Shi Sheng and Mrs. Nangong stayed until the banquet started, and then they went down together. Nangong Jing left early in the morning, probably because he was worried about Su Yiyi.

Shi Sheng doesn’t like socializing, but in this circle, these socializings are necessary.

"Ms. Xu is getting more and more beautiful as she grows older. Mr. Jing is so lucky. Unlike that boy in our family, he still has no whereabouts yet." The dignified woman looked at Mrs. Nangong with envy, causing several women next to her to agree.

"So this good wife must make a decision early."

"Hey, it also depends on whether you are lucky or not. Look at the one from the Lin family, isn't it also a baby kiss? What's the result? The whole family is in trouble. Hey, I'm not talking about Miss Xu, don't worry about it, Miss Xu."

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ off ​​​

Shi Sheng pulled the corners of her mouth and smiled perfunctorily, her eyes full of impatience. If the car hadn't been outside when she woke up, she would never have come in.

“Three women have one drama, how many dramas can this group of women have?

"Aunt, my father is here, I'll go over there." When Shi Sheng saw Xu's father, he immediately made an excuse and ran away.

These people are rich, powerful and have everything, and their only entertainment is comparison.

"Compared to my father, my husband, my children, it seems that if I win, I will be superior to others."

"Dad." Shi Sheng walked up to Xu's father and called out in a gentle manner.

"Girl, you came so early, why aren't you with A Jing?" Father Xu looked around behind her, but didn't see Nangong Jing, so he couldn't help but feel a little confused.

"Well, he has something to do." The smile on Shi Sheng's face became more sincere, "Why didn't mom come?"

"I had something to do at the company, so I went to the branch. When will you, the girl, care about us two old people? I thought you only had your sweetheart in your eyes!" Xu's father joked, his face full of joy, which shows how much Xu's father dotes on the original owner.

"People will grow up." Shi Sheng blinked.

"Okay, okay, our girl has grown up."

The core has been changed, so of course it’s different!

One of the last wishes of the original owner was to honor his parents.

Father Xu took Shi Sheng to toast the birthday girl tonight, and then led Shi Sheng around in the crowd. As soon as he slipped down, he knew everyone he should know.

Father Xu felt more and more pleased that his daughter was so well-behaved today. She had indeed grown up.

Shi Sheng drank some wine and felt a little dizzy. He told Xu's father and walked to the garden to wake up.

Nangong’s garden was very large. Shi Sheng found a place to sit. The cool breeze at night made her head sober.

"What were you doing with him just now?" The angry voice woke up the drowsy Shi Sheng.

Shi Sheng rubbed his face, pulled up the back of his chair and looked behind him. There were several trees behind him, and there were two vague figures standing behind them.
